scores.notes: Jesus calls toward the wrapped Lazarus at the tomb, with the requested crowd on the right. White paper remains along the watercolor's left and lower edges, an accepted exception.
Jesus stands at the stern with an upraised hand as disciples watch on settling water. Small irregular white watercolor gaps reach the side edges; these are accepted.
Peter steps across the water between the boat of watching disciples and Jesus. The night scene is coherent and fills the canvas without inscriptions.
Fire falls onto two walled cities while people flee across the foreground and plain. The fleeing people fit the scene, and the cloud contains no human-shaped deity.
David kneels beside the brook lifting a smooth stone, with sling, pouch and staff visible. Distant ranks are faintly present and no unrelated foreground figure appears.
The youths jeer at the bald prophet by the city gate, but he is walking downhill away from the elevated gate rather than climbing toward it as requested.
Peter freezes beside the courtyard fire with Jesus visible in the rear doorway and a rooster above. Jesus and the bystanders are explicitly requested by the scene.
Light streams through the city gate as people carry grain and jars; no separate bodily figure represents Wisdom. Irregular white paper margins are present and accepted.
Families, livestock and Moses cross a dry corridor between water walls. The divine presence has no bodily form; ragged white margins at the bottom and sides are accepted.
Heart and spade glyphs are visibly painted on cards and hoops across the lawn. Alice holds the flamingo below the floating cat head; white paper margins are accepted.
Disciples reach toward the reclining Jesus while others bail water from the storm-tossed boat. Small white paper patches along the lower side margins are accepted.
Two attendants lift the unhurt Daniel inside the pit while Darius reaches from the rim and lions rest below. The rope and grouped figures form a single coherent rescue scene.

Peter raises the seated man while two other prominent men stand beside them, one touching the patient's head. One can be John, but the other's identity as a crowd member or an unrequested extra participant is not visually settled.
Heart, diamond and spade glyphs cover the card soldiers and the Queen's skirt. Alice, flamingo and hedgehog fit the croquet scene; small unpainted corner areas are accepted.
Peter steps out of the boat toward Jesus on the night water. A white paper band surrounds a plain thin rectangular outline; the band is accepted and the outline is not ornamental.
Moses holds the rod aloft beside abundant water issuing from the rock, while people and livestock drink. Aaron is visible in priestly dress as explicitly requested.

The Rabbit's paper and loose floor sheets contain writing, and card suits are visible. Two crowned Kings appear simultaneously, the chained Knave is a rounded human rather than a flat card, and small white edge gaps are accepted.
Disciples stand by the landed boat, fish-filled net and cooking coals on the shore. No distinctly identified Jesus figure appears; small white watercolor edge gaps are accepted.
The lone prophet raises his hand over a valley of scattered dry skeletons; his board shows no visible writing. Broad white paper margins and blank upper corners are accepted.
A luminous, nonfigurative cloud rests above the central tabernacle while families sit among surrounding tents. The camp is at rest and the painted scene reaches every edge.
Daniel gestures steadily toward the seated king in a banquet hall with a blank wall behind. Small irregular white corner slivers are accepted; the wall and vessels have no writing.

Holmes sits alone beside the empty chair and fireplace, but his dark curls and distinctive long, angular face strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch's screen Holmes. Small white edge gaps are accepted.
Job stands on an ash heap with pottery beneath a vast whirlwind and rays of light. Neither the cloud nor the light forms a divine face or body.

The pursuing army enters the sea corridor, but the central foreground horse is positioned inside/behind the chariot instead of pulling it, making the harness arrangement incoherent. White watercolor gaps at the edges are accepted.

The hovering beings have exposed feet and conventional angel bodies, and several cover faces with hands rather than wings. The central angel exposes its face and carries a coal, failing the requested six-winged, veiled seraphim scene.
Daniel stands unharmed among quiet closed-mouthed lions while Darius watches from the rim. The surrounding radiance is only light, without a separate angelic face or body.
Moses extends his hand beside the parted sea at night, with Israelites waiting on the shore. The vertical glow above the passage has no face, limbs or robe.

Watson waits with a revolver on the foreground crate while three companions watch the floor glint. A small ruled inscription-like label appears on the upper right case; irregular white edge gaps are accepted.
Saul and companions shield their eyes beneath a faceless burst of radiance outside the city. The roadside marker at lower right bears small dark inscription-like marks.
The elderly man lies with eyes closed and folded hands amid quiet mourners in the courtyard. Although the selected list is empty, Adam and these mourners are expressly requested in the scene.
Moses sits on a stone with raised arms braced by Aaron and Hur while warriors fight below. The two rods are unusual but do not create an impossible pose or an additional moment.
Visible print covers the airborne newspaper bundle and loose sheets. Holmes's curly hair and distinctive profile strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch; the white watercolor margins are accepted.
People carry grain and jars through the brightly lit gate and raise their hands. Wisdom is conveyed through illumination without a separate supernatural human figure.
Moses gestures toward the horizon before the mountain while families and livestock gather behind. The scene is continuous, dignified and fully painted to its edges.
The Gryphon and sad turtle-like creature gesture around Alice on a shingle beach, with lobsters and turtles in the distance. The hybrid anatomy is consistent with the requested fantastical creatures.
The station sign reads EYFORD and the train carries visible lettering, including GREAT. The station-master points toward the distant smoke beside Bradstreet; white watercolor edge gaps are accepted.
Alice addresses a grinning, clawed cat perched on a branch in the dense wood. The animal remains a cat and no extra figure, text or border appears.
Moses points ahead while families, bundles and goats gather beneath the mountain. The figures and landscape form the requested single departure scene.
Light spreads diagonally across dark primordial water and mist, with no land or people visible. The illuminated cloud does not resolve into a face or human form.
Job braces himself on one knee, rising among ash and broken pottery before the whirlwind. Cloud and light stay nonfigurative; irregular white paper areas at the edges are accepted.

Six living creatures surround the throne, including duplicate ox and human forms, instead of the requested four. The divine throne contains light without a discernible body; the duplication is the material fault.
The Levite holds a knife beside a fully shrouded body, with lamplight and a donkey in the doorway. The restrained scene shows no gore or exposed injury.
David kneels at the stream lifting a stone, with staff, sling and pouch nearby and distant ranks behind. The broad white watercolor margins are accepted.
Disciples strain at an oar, rigging and bailing bucket as waves break against their boat beneath a torn sail. Irregular white areas reaching the side edges are accepted.
The father opens his arms toward the kneeling son as servants approach with robe, ring and sandals. The extra servant within the group does not introduce an unrelated prominent subject.
A white-robed human figure with a head, arms and seated body occupies the central fiery throne. This visibly gives the Ancient of Days a forbidden bodily form despite the surrounding cloud and fire.
Jesus reclines asleep on the stern cushion while frightened disciples lean toward him and bail the flooded boat. The storm, poses and objects form a coherent single moment.

Five winged creatures appear around the throne, including an additional human-faced quadruped below the human-faced figure. The throne itself is faceless radiance, and the white watercolor margins are accepted.
The father embraces and kisses the bowed younger son on the rural road. Their overlapping arms are traceable to the two figures, with no clear extra limb.

Jesus raises his hand beside the open tomb as Lazarus stands outside with visible head and wrist wrappings, watched by the crowd. The brown outer shroud differs from a fully bandaged depiction but the requested event remains identifiable.
A single weary traveler takes a firmer upright step along the stony road below Jerusalem. There is no additional divine or narrator figure.
Peter stands shocked by the courtyard fire, with bound Jesus in the distant doorway and a rooster on the wall. Small white paper slivers along the lower edge are accepted.
An elderly traveler straightens and steps along the rocky road with Jerusalem behind him. No other figure, inscription or artificial frame is visible.

Card suits, including heart and diamond glyphs and a corner rank mark, are visible on the soldiers and Queen's dress. Alice holds the floating head while the King inspects it; no clear peripheral paper band is present.
Printed newspaper columns and clock numerals are visible in the sitting room. Holmes strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch, and the irregular white paper margins are accepted.
Samuel pours oil from a horn onto kneeling David while Jesse and three brothers watch. The glow around David has no separate Spirit face or body, and the hands and limbs remain coherent.
Moses leads families and livestock through a dry passage between towering water walls containing fish. No divine face or body appears in the sky or sea.
Jesus stands with one hand raised over calm water as disciples watch from the boat. Buckets, cushion and ropes fit the aftermath of the storm, with no visible inscriptions.
Moses gestures beside priestly Aaron while families watch a pig rooting at the camp's edge. The distant cloud is nonfigurative, and the breastplate appears to contain stones rather than writing.
Naomi holds the swaddled infant amid attentive women in a Bethlehem courtyard. These people are explicitly requested in the scene despite only the house appearing in the selected list.
Saul shields his eyes as companions recoil beneath a diffuse sky light. Small glyph-like marks are visible on the red cap of the roadside marker; no sky figure appears.
Peter stands beside the courtyard fire with bound Jesus in the distant doorway and the rooster above. The requested bystanders surround the same continuous scene.

Card-suit glyphs cover the soldiers. Alice directs a separate wooden stick toward the hedgehog while merely carrying the flamingo, so the requested attempt to strike with the flamingo's head is not shown.

Writing covers jury slates and floor papers, and suit glyphs mark the cards. The Queen's heart-shaped red hair, tiny crown and white-faced design recall the film Red Queen; whether the Hatter actually bites the cup rather than food at its rim is visually ambiguous.
The plaque above Jesus contains small inscription-like marks, and marked lots lie beside the soldiers. The crucifixion is restrained without gore, and white paper edges are accepted.
A seated believer holds a dimly reflecting bronze mirror while turning toward a companion in the bright doorway. The two figures, furnishings and courtyard form a single coherent scene.
The slip, tabletop letters, books and lower-right signature contain writing. Holmes and Watson visibly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman, violating the screen-likeness restriction.

Writing is visible across the table and scattered papers, with numerals on the mantel clock. Holmes's face and curly hairstyle strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch; the artwork fills its edges without a clear paper margin.

The newspaper on the right chair and foreground papers contain print. Holmes and Watson strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman while otherwise performing the requested hat examination.
Holmes draws Watson by the arm while red-haired Wilson sits nearby, with writing visible on scattered newspapers. Holmes's facial likeness and hair clearly evoke Benedict Cumberbatch.
The shop board is blank and the assistant, Holmes and Watson occupy the requested street scene. Holmes's distinctive angular face and curled hair resemble Benedict Cumberbatch's screen portrayal.
Hatherley points beside the burning house, roses and fire engines while Holmes watches. Holmes closely resembles Benedict Cumberbatch, and irregular white paper margins are accepted.

Moses extends the staff over the opening sea corridor as people wait along the shore. The cloud pillar is irregular light and vapor without a definite human form; small white corner gaps are accepted.
Daniel gestures before the seated king in the torchlit banquet hall. The large wall is blank, and the surrounding courtiers are requested by the scene.
Daniel faces fire and cloud over burning wheels, with attendant ranks on either side. The central blaze contains no discernible face, limbs, robe or human-shaped Ancient of Days.
Heart and rank glyphs appear on the King and soldiers, with suit-like motifs on the hoops. Alice holds the disembodied cat head, the King peers beside her and the Queen passes behind.
Writing appears on the floor papers and heart/spade glyphs mark the court. The small heart-clad courtiers at the edges have rounded dressed bodies rather than the required flat oblong card forms.
Darius presses a seal onto a stone lying beside the open pit, while the den remains uncovered. The stone therefore does not seal the mouth as the requested action requires.
Moses points toward the horizon with families, bundles and livestock beneath the mountain. White paper is exposed along the lower edge and corners, an accepted exception.
Disciples stop on the shore facing fish and bread on the coals, with a fish-filled net in the foreground boat. No distinct Jesus figure or unrelated participant is visible.
Several seraphim expose feet, use hands to cover faces, and lack the required six-wing arrangement; the central coal-bearing angel exposes its face. White watercolor corner areas are accepted.
Rephaiah gestures toward masons repairing the wall, with stone carriers, a trowel and a loaded cart below. The people are requested in the scene, and no inscriptions are visible.

The boat, net, fish and bread on coals match the shore scene. The long-haired man foremost at right could be an ordinary disciple or a Jesus-like figure; there is insufficient distinctive evidence to affirm an extra Jesus, so identity remains uncertain.
Suit glyphs mark the background card soldiers. The floating cat's round furry face, turquoise stripes, huge green eyes and toothy grin closely reproduce the film Cheshire Cat design.

Alice sits apart while the Hatter and Hare protest beside the sleeping Dormouse at the garden table. The sleeper's broad muzzle is somewhat cat-like, but rounded ears and its sleepy posture do not establish a different species.

Daniel braces his hands on the pit rim as an attendant supports him from behind and Darius reaches down. Only one attendant is clearly visible, but the requested rescue action is evident and no impossible limb is apparent.

Goliath topples sideways onto an elbow while David stands with both hands empty and no visible sling. This does not clearly show the requested sling release and face-first collapse; white paper margins are accepted.

The foreground believer turns toward the companion in the doorway, but the mirror held facing outward still presents his frontal face despite his position and turned head. The reflection does not agree with the depicted pose.
The Levite holds a knife beside the clothed, motionless woman under lamplight, with the donkey outside. The scene is solemn and free of gore; no clear unpainted edge or inscription is visible.
The sleeping animal between the Hatter and Hare has conspicuously long rabbit ears and a rabbit face instead of being a Dormouse. White paper margins are visible and accepted.

Holmes holds the flare and cane beside the bell-pull while Watson recoils on the bed. A small signature-like inscription appears at lower right, and the two faces strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman.
Adam lies with closed eyes and folded hands as family members sit around the mat bed in a courtyard. The scene is restrained and coherent, with no gore, lettering or frame.
Faint writing runs down the Rabbit's scroll and heart/rank glyphs appear on the card figures. The chained Knave at right is a rounded human boy rather than a flat oblong playing card.
Alice drinks from a bottle with a blank tag, but the garden door stands open admitting daylight rather than being shut in the lamp-only hall requested. Small white paper edge patches are accepted.
The believer holds a dim facial reflection while turning toward the companion in the sunlit doorway. Small white watercolor edge gaps are accepted; no writing is visible.

Holmes and Watson inspect the shop with its blank board and three gilt balls while the assistant stands in the doorway. The faces suggest familiar screen portrayals but are not distinctive enough to affirm a likeness; white paper margins are accepted.
Paul speaks with a raised hand to a small gathering in a whitewashed courtyard. The listeners are requested, and the closed scrolls at his belt show no writing.
Lazarus steps from the lamp-lit tomb with wrappings on his head, wrists and lower legs as Jesus raises a hand. The watching crowd fits the scene and no additional divine figure appears.

Alice leans toward the sleepy central animal between the Hare and Hatter, but that animal has tall pointed rabbit-like ears and a broad feline/rabbit muzzle rather than a Dormouse. The table and conversation otherwise fit the requested scene.
The lone prophet lifts his hand over a wide valley of bleached bones and scattered skeletons. No writing is visible on the held board, and the disarticulated bones suit the requested subject.

Bottle labels on the mantel and foreground table contain small writing. Holmes's face and hair strongly resemble Benedict Cumberbatch as he examines the blue gem; the image has no clear unpainted margin.

Holmes brandishes the cane toward the right-hand wall while the bell-pull is behind him at upper left, so he is not lashing the requested target. His face closely resembles Benedict Cumberbatch; small white corner slivers are accepted.

Three helpers flank the seated Moses instead of Aaron and Hur alone, and only one of his arms is raised while the other holds a low staff. The extra helper and altered support action depart from the requested hillside group.
Peter draws the man upward by the hand on the temple steps while John watches close beside him. The mat, alms bowl and background crowd fit the scene, with no clear extra figure or malformed limb.
